name: intent-e2e-cross-process-open-assumption
body: The in-flight intent observation relies on redb's multi-writer open not blocking behind another process's idle handle (only brief write transactions matter); it passed three consecutive runs, but if a future engine serialises cross-process open the test degrades to the deterministic post-exit assertions. Upgrade to a side-channel marker (e.g. an intent-written sentinel file) at that point.
